Read a Submission Profile from Portable JSON

Source: R/serialize_profile.R
read_profile.Rd

Reads a JSON document produced by write_profile() back into a submission_profile. The structure is checked the same way a caller-built profile is: the reconstruction is routed through custom_profile(), so the imported profile must satisfy exactly the structural invariants applied to the shipped profiles (pillar weights sum to 1, decision bands integer- contiguous over 0-100, RPN bands integer-contiguous over 1-125). A document that fails them is rejected rather than silently repaired.

Usage

read_profile(file)

Arguments

file

A single string: either a path to a JSON file written by write_profile(), or the JSON string itself.

Value

A submission_profile object equivalent to the one that was written.

Details

Only values present in the document are used; no weight, threshold, or other value is invented or defaulted in.

See also

write_profile().

Examples

prof <- submission_profile("EMA", "MAA")
json <- write_profile(prof)
prof2 <- read_profile(json)
identical(prof, prof2)
#> [1] TRUE
